purpose: Explanation-only links from decisive missing executable facts to address CSV validation issues; no value binding or changes to applicability.

review.method: Reviewed finite distinct fact semantic names, descriptions, data types, and subject scopes from the current plans; expanded approved families into exact fully qualified keys. Runtime matching uses exact keys only.
excluded_semantics: Certificate-of-occupancy issuance or existence; construction completion existence without timing
Owner portfolio, owner holdings, and unrelated landlords or competitors
Counts of occupants, tenants, owners, memberships, and bedrooms
Family classification or capacity rather than unit counts
Demolition and conversion project units or sites, new hypothetical buildings, and percentage thresholds
Rented units or bedrooms combined without an independently identified unit count
review.scope_policy: Links to building, premises, subset, rental, and event-scoped counts only explain related source issues. Their legal counting scope and relevant date remain independent, unbound facts. Construction dates likewise remain distinct from calendar-year intervals and certificate dates.
